item.title: [Sistemas / Cloud] CVE-2026-130380 - Windows Server
item.description:
🚨 CVE-2026-130380 - Windows Server
 
Criticidade: Alta
Ferramenta: Windows Server
Fonte: NVD
CVSS: 8.1
Resumo:
AdminNeo before 5.9.1 contains an authentication bypass vulnerability in the sqlsrv-based MS SQL driver that allows unauthenticated attackers to log in by submitting an empty username. Attackers can supply any non-empty password, triggering Windows integrated authentication that grants a full session with the web server identity's SQL Server privileges.
Link: https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-130380

item.description:

Criticidade: Alta
Ferramenta: Qualys
Fonte: The Hacker News
CVSS: 7.0
Resumo:
A Java flaw called Java4Shell can let attackers without an account run their own code on Jira, Jenkins, Keycloak, and three other widely used applications, says Calif, the security research firm that disclosed it this week. The flaw is present in Java 17.0.6 and later, and the vulnerable code runs only on x86-64 Intel and AMD chips that support the AVX-512 VBMI feature.
